approach: Add a new core module code_health.rs with pure functions (measure files, count landings and citations, apply thresholds, build structural-pass and design-review request texts, dedupe against open requests) and one thin `Athena::code_health_after_landing` that loads records and the head tree, runs them, and commits any new queued requests with the existing Committer. Hook it into `note_finished` (steward.rs, called by `go` after every finished job) for Landed, and after a confirmed merge in `Athena::land_pr` (gh.rs). Because dedup and the 10-landing cadence are derived from records, not counters, a second call is harmless. StatusView gets a `code_health` field built from the same measures; display.rs renders it as a table. No new dependency: function length is measured by a brace-matching scan.

decisions.choice: Function length by a brace-matching scan in code_health.rs that skips line/block comments, string/char literals and raw strings; a `fn` item runs from its signature line to the matching close brace.
decisions.reason: syn is not a direct dependency (not in the workspace Cargo.toml); adding it with the full feature adds build time and a new dependency for a threshold check that tolerates a few lines of error. Recorded as the buy-versus-build call in decisions.md.

rejected.why: New dependency and compile cost for a coarse 200-line threshold; revisit if the scan misreports.
Misreads nested closures and braces in strings.

decisions.choice: Production lines = non-test lines of each tracked .rs file: drop the item following `#[cfg(test)]` (a `mod` block, matched by braces) and any `tests/` directory or `*_tests.rs` file. Blank and comment-only lines are not counted. Only .rs files under crates/ and xtask/ are measured.
decisions.reason: The request says production lines; the brief assumes #[cfg(test)] exclusion.

rejected.why: Penalises well-tested files and contradicts the brief.

decisions.choice: Thresholds are pub consts in code_health.rs (2000 lines, 200-line function, 1500 lines with 5 or more landings in 7 days); athena.toml is untouched.
decisions.reason: Out of scope to change athena.toml or defaults.toml; constants are testable.

decisions.choice: Per-file landings in the last 7 days: request jobs whose outcome (or later_outcome) is Landed with `at` within 7 days of now, counted against each path in candidate.changes. Citations: request jobs with outcome Rejected or Failed whose candidate.changes include the path or whose verification.reasons or summary contain the path text.
decisions.reason: These are the records already in Records; no new store is needed.

rejected.option: Read the records branch landings/ directory
rejected.why: Its commits do not name the files per job without more reads, and it is absent in plain copies.

decisions.choice: Test run time is read from the most recent verification's check named `test` (CheckRun.duration.best_lower()); absent shows as `not recorded`. The check never runs cargo test itself.
decisions.reason: The brief forbids running the suite in the check; verification already records the duration.

rejected.option: Time cargo test inside the check
rejected.why: Minutes per landing and recursion risk.

decisions.choice: Dedup and cadence come from records. An open structural-pass request is any request job with first line `Structural pass: <path>` whose state is not Closed. The design review fires when the number of Landed request jobs whose outcome is later than the latest request with first line `Design review (periodic)` is 10 or more. Both are queued on REQUEST_CHANNEL (so `athena drain` works them) with a `Priority: high` line for the design review.
decisions.reason: No counter file to drift or double-count when both `go` and the PR merge hook run for one job; separate from steward-count, so the steward's cadence and tick() are unchanged.

rejected.why: Double-counts when two hooks run for one landing and needs a lock.
Out of scope: it would couple to the steward cadence.
Needs a DRAINED_CHANNELS change, which is a change to the steward's behaviour.

decisions.choice: Structural-pass request text cites the numbers: lines, longest function with its name and line count, landings in 7 days, citations, and the threshold crossed. It asks for a structural pass only (no behaviour change) and does not perform it.
decisions.reason: Request says to cite the numbers; the refactors are out of scope.

files.purpose: Measures, thresholds, breach rules, request texts, dedup, 10-landing design-review rule, Athena::code_health_after_landing, tests.
Add `pub mod code_health;` and a line in the module list.
In note_finished, call the code-health check for a Landed outcome (after the nested guard); no change to tick or cadence.
After a confirmed merge in Athena::land_pr, call the same idempotent check; a warning line on error, never changing the landing result.
Add `code_health` to StatusView and fill it in Athena::status.
Render the code-health table in `status`; update the test StatusView fixtures.
New decision: thresholds, scan versus syn, the 10-landing cadence from records.

steps: Read run_pin_tests.rs and test_support.rs for a scratch repository with records and an Athena value to reuse in the new tests; read the Committer API in commits.rs and the record constructors used by steward tests.

Create code_health.rs: constants; `FileHealth`, `Breach`, `CodeHealth` (serde Serialize); `production_lines`, `longest_function`; `landings_by_file` and `citations_by_file` over Records with a `now` argument; `check(files, records, now)`; the `test_secs` reader; `structural_request(file)` and `design_review_due(records)` with the marker constants; dedup against non-closed requests.

Add `Athena::code_health_after_landing(&self, ui)`: load head tree .rs files via ls_tree and show_file, build the report, build new requests with RequestQueue-style records (channel steward, fresh RecordId not in taken), and commit them in one Committer::commit_records with Athena-Job trailers; print one ui line per request.
Add the mod in lib.rs; call from steward.rs note_finished for Landed (after the nested guard) and from gh.rs land_pr after a confirmed merge.

Add `code_health: CodeHealth` to StatusView and fill it in Athena::status from the head tree and records, without queuing anything; render the table in display.rs (path, lines, longest fn, landings 7d, citations, breach marker, thresholds footer, test run time); fix every StatusView fixture.
Write the tests named in the demonstrations; run cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings and cargo test.
Add the CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry and the docs/decisions.md decision.

risks.risk: The brace scan misreads unusual Rust, giving a wrong longest function.
risks.mitigation: Test the scan on fixtures with braces in strings, comments, raw strings, closures and nested fns; treat the number as a measure, not an exact count.

risks.risk: A failure or slow tree read in the check delays or breaks a landing.
risks.mitigation: Run after the landing with errors turned into one ui warning line; the check never changes the outcome and reads git objects only.

risks.risk: The hook runs from both go and the PR merge and queues duplicates.
risks.mitigation: A request is queued only while no non-closed request has that first line; a test covers repeat calls and the closed case.

risks.risk: The first-line marker for a design review collides with request 20261017-205558-dn2e's own text.
risks.mitigation: Keep the marker strings as constants shared by the writer and the dedup reader and test them together; the design-review text only names the review and its priority, not the role prompt.

risks.risk: Test run time is missing for repositories with no recorded verification.
risks.mitigation: Mark status as `not recorded` when no check named `test` exists, and in the report.

demonstrations.method: Unit test builds fixture source strings (production code plus a #[cfg(test)] mod) and Records with landed jobs dated inside and outside 7 days and rejected jobs citing a path, then calls the measure and breach functions.
demonstrations.observes: Exact production line count, longest function length, weekly landing count (a landing 8 days old is excluded), citation count, and one breach entry per threshold kind.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the cfg(test) exclusion the fixture's production count is too high and the assertion fails; without the breach rules, the three breach assertions (a 2001-line file, a 201-line function, a 1501-line file with 5 landings in 7 days and none for a 4-landing control file) fail.

demonstrations.method: Test in a scratch repository: commit a breaching file and records, run the queue step, load Records, then run again, and separately run with an open structural-pass request for the file, and again once that request is closed.
demonstrations.observes: Exactly one new request job on channel steward whose text contains the file path, its line count and the threshold; zero new requests on the second run and with an open request; one again after the open request is closed.
demonstrations.fails_without: If dedup were missing, the second call or the call with an open request would queue another request and the count assertion would fail; if citing were missing, the text assertion would fail.

demonstrations.method: Test records 9 landed request jobs and runs the review check, asserts none; adds a 10th and asserts one request with a Priority: high line (JobRecords::priority() == High); runs again and asserts no second; asserts steward::finished_since_run is unchanged.
demonstrations.observes: No design-review request at 9, one high-priority request at 10, none after, and the steward counter untouched.
demonstrations.fails_without: An off-by-one or a counter tied to the steward fails: 9 landings must queue nothing and the 10th must queue one.

demonstrations.method: Test calls `Athena::note_finished(OutcomeState::Landed, ..)` on a scratch repository holding a breaching file and a verification with a `test` check of known duration, then reads Records and the report.
demonstrations.observes: A structural-pass request exists after the call, and the report carries the recorded test duration.
demonstrations.fails_without: If note_finished did not call the check, no request would appear after a Landed outcome on a breaching fixture repo and the assertion fails; a Rejected outcome must not run it.

demonstrations.method: Display test builds a StatusView with a code_health section (one breaching file, one clean) and asserts on `display::status(&view)`; a status.rs test checks that Athena::status fills the field from fixture records.
demonstrations.observes: Text contains a header row, each file's lines, longest function, landings, citations, the 2000/200/1500-and-5 thresholds, a BREACH marker on the breaching file and `test suite` run time.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the table were missing, the rendered text would lack the file path, its lines, longest function, weekly landings, citations, the threshold figures or the test run time.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks as listed.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.fails_without: Any warning, format difference or failing test fails the command.

demonstrations.observes: A CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry and a new docs/decisions.md entry giving the three thresholds, the scan-versus-syn call and the 10-landing cadence derived from records.

open_questions: Which job counts as a 'landing' for the design-review cadence when Athena::go lands locally and the PR merges later: the plan counts Landed request jobs once each, from the outcome record.
Whether the files that sit outside crates/ and xtask/ should be measured; the plan limits to .rs files there.

Cargo.toml and land.rs are in the expected deliverables, but the plan leaves them unchanged (no new dependency; note_finished and land_pr already cover the landing path). If the producer finds a reason to change them, it must say so.
The exact StatusView construction sites in other crates' tests are not all seen; the producer must grep for `StatusView {` and add the new field.
